# Gramlot examples 0.2.14

- Add Python-first publish/subscribe and parent/child messaging lessons, with matching JavaScript, references and native ask.
- Replace the gallery inspector button with a compact accessible emoji control.
- Include an interactive serverless example and inspector in each manual lesson, preserving the chronological learning sequence.
- Require Gramlot 0.2.18 or later for the messaging examples and shared inspector.

Release validation also runs both new messaging lessons in the complete per-page browser suite. Version 0.2.13 was tagged but not published because that suite lacked the new entries; this release retains the original tag and fixes the coverage gap.
